A '''repeater beacon''' was a type of communications beacon. Repeater beacons were utilized in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]] to form the [[RiftMesh]] communications network.<ref name="Crucible">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>
{{Tech-stub}}
 
==Behind the scenes==
Repeater beacons featured in the [[2013]] [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] novel [[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']], written by [[Troy Denning]].<ref name="Crucible" />
